Tender Notice — Professional Services Contract

REQ-01: The supplier must hold valid public liability insurance to a minimum value of €6.5 million per claim.
REQ-02: A current tax clearance certificate from Revenue must be submitted with the tender response.
REQ-03: A current safety statement and risk assessment (RAMS) must be provided prior to commencement.
REQ-04: Audited accounts for the last three financial years must be submitted. Minimum annual turnover of €500,000 is required.
REQ-05: The supplier shall demonstrate a minimum of 5 years experience delivering similar contracts.
REQ-06: A method statement outlining the approach to service delivery must be included.
REQ-07: Staff CVs and evidence of relevant qualifications must be submitted.
REQ-08: A copy of the company data protection policy must be provided.
REQ-09: The solution should provide API access for integration with existing systems.
REQ-10: Pricing information to be submitted using the standard pricing schedule.
